name: Basic
description: Classic LEGO Bricks, Plates, and Tiles can be stacked vertically by attaching the round studs with a small amount of pressure.

name: Wall
description: Panels, walls, doors, and related parts make it easier to construct models than using bricks and plates alone.

name: SNOT
description: These parts allow you to attach studs facing outwards (Studs Not On Top) or attach studs at an offset from the normal grid.

name: Angle
description: Slopes, wedges, and windscreens allow you to include angled sections in your model.

name: Curve
description: Build streamlined or organic shapes using a rich palette of curved parts.

name: Articulation
description: Parts that bend or rotate, allowing for a wide range of interesting building techniques.

name: Minifig
description: The classic LEGO Minifigure and Friends Minidoll live in a rich world of clothing, accessories, weapons, and containers.

name: Nature
description: Plants, animals, teeth, tails, and elemental forces bring the LEGO world to life.

name: Vehicle
description: Wheels allow your model to move, brackets make them stronger, noses make them look faster, and tracks give them somewhere to go.

name: Technic
description: Technic is a system unto itself, with a focus on connecting parts using pins and axles, but you will find plenty of Technic parts with studs as well.

name: Electronics
description: Add light and motion to your creations using LEGO hubs, motors, lights, and sensors.

name: DUPLO
description: The larger bricks for younger kids are twice as big in each direction and compatible with regular LEGO bricks.
